subject.title: feat(plugins): support per-agent plugin installation with --agent flag

question: Should OpenClaw accept per-agent managed plugin installs in core now, and should the scope live in install-record identity, activation/discovery state, or a separate agent plugin contract?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not only code cleanup; the feature changes public CLI behavior, persisted install records, plugin activation, update/uninstall cleanup, and plugin trust boundaries.

options.title: Pause for a scoped-plugin contract
options.body: Require a maintainer-approved design covering record identity, runtime discovery, uninstall/update cleanup, security policy, and upgrade behavior before repairing this PR.

options.title: Narrow this PR to groundwork only
options.body: Remove the public `--agent` flag for now and keep only any internally useful refactor that does not create scoped install records.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Close or park this PR and keep the broader feature issue as the canonical place for product/security decisions.

recommendation.title: Pause for a scoped-plugin contract
recommendation.body: Require a maintainer-approved design covering record identity, runtime discovery, uninstall/update cleanup, security policy, and upgrade behavior before repairing this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the most recent current-main changes in the central plugin install/uninstall files and has adjacent merged recovery work.
